8900: Stand facing away from the cable and hold the handle at chest height.
Step into a staggered stance and brace your core.
Punch forward fast and rotate your torso slightly.
Stop short of locking out your elbow.
Pull the hand back under control.
8901: Stand side-on to the low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Avoid leaning or swinging, then switch arms.

Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
